title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay San Andres, Municipality of Kadingilan, Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the San Andres National High School
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay San Andres, Municipality of Kadingilan, Province of Bukidnon, to Be Known as the San Andres National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay San Andres, Thị trấn Kadingilan, Tỉnh Bukidnon được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia San Andres
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ San Andres, เทศบาล Kadingilan, จังหวัด Bukidnon ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ San Andres
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay San Andres, Kotamadya Kadingilan, Provinsi Bukidnon dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional San Andres
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay San Andres, Perbandaran Kadingilan, Wilayah Bukidnon dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan San Andres

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_7867_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Barangay San Andres, Municipality of Kadingilan, Province of Bukidnon, to be known as the San Andres National High School.
the Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue the necessary rules and regulations for the effective implementation of this Act.
the amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
